title: SWE-1: THE FIRST FAMILY
lede: May 15, 2025 — weeks before the acquisition was signed — Windsurf shipped its own model family in the Wave 9 release: three tiers trained not to autocomplete code, but to survive the whole software-engineering process. It became the foundation of Cognition's in-house model line.
body:
h2. THE THESIS: FLOW AWARENESS

p. The SWE-1 launch post argued that coding models were trained on the wrong task. Real engineering isn't 'produce the right snippet' — it's a %(hl)shared timeline% of half-finished states: the file you opened, the command that failed, the diff you're about to revert. SWE-1 was trained with %(cyan)flow awareness% — a model of the developer's whole working session, not just the text cursor.

h2. THE THREE TIERS

table(specs).
|_. tier|_. role|_. fine print|
|%(ok)SWE-1%|the flagship tool-caller inside Cascade|~Claude 3.5 Sonnet-level tool-call reasoning, cheaper to serve; free promo for paid users|
|%(amber)SWE-1-lite%|the unlimited tier|replaced Cascade Base at better quality; unlimited for every user, free or paid|
|%(cyan)SWE-1-mini%|the reflexes|small enough to run inside Tab's latency budget; further trained for predictive actions rather than tool calls|

h2. WHY IT MATTERED

* It proved Windsurf could %(ok)post-train its own frontier-adjacent model% instead of renting one — the capability Cognition was really acquiring two months later.
* The tiering pattern — flagship / unlimited / reflex — became the permanent architecture of the SWE line.
* It established the SWE name and the family tradition: %(amber)every subsequent release is optimized for the harness it lives in%, not a chat arena.

bq. We are launching our first family of models, dubbed SWE-1, optimized for the entire software engineering process, not just the task of coding. %(dim)— Cognition, May 15, 2025%

h2. THE GENEALOGY

bc(ascii). SWE-1 family (may 2025)
├── SWE-1 ....... flagship tool-call model, Cascade
├── SWE-1-lite .. unlimited tier, replaces Cascade Base
└── SWE-1-mini .. Tab predictive engine, latency-class
